summary: This joint resolution prohibits the proposed sale of specific defense articles and services, including CH-47F Block II Chinook helicopters and related equipment, to the Government of the United Arab Emirates.

scores.thoughts: This bill directly concerns a proposed military sale of defense articles and services to the UAE. While it aims to disapprove the sale, the core subject matter is military equipment and services, making it highly relevant to military and defense spending, specifically regarding arms exports.
